question.text: Unlisted debt securities WITHOUT an ascertainable market are valued at:

answer.text: Amortized Cost plus accrued interest (if any)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 269, unlisted securities with no ascertainable market are valued at amortized cost plus accrued interest, if any. Page 271 illustrates the same treatment for unlisted debt being carried at amortized cost. The Trap: Face value, equity market price, and zero are not the prescribed methods for unlisted debt without an ascertainable market. Note: Anchor the answer on the amortized-cost-plus-accrued-interest rule as stated in the workbook.
